# skill: family-care

Use for a baby, school year, elderly parent or pet; no diagnosis

# family-care — baby, school, elder and pet care paperwork

> **One rule:** Organise visits, rights and paperwork. Never judge a symptom, and never suggest a medicine or a dose.

## Pick the part

| Job (what the user says) | Open |
|---|---|
| "We are expecting, or we have a new baby. What visits and rights apply?" | [`references/pregnancy-and-baby.md`](references/pregnancy-and-baby.md) |
| "Plan my child's school year, fees and tutoring" | [`references/kids-school.md`](references/kids-school.md) |
| "I look after an elderly parent. Help with appointments, medicines and home safety" | [`references/elder-care.md`](references/elder-care.md) |
| "We keep a dog or cat. Vaccines, vet record and yearly budget" | [`references/pet-care.md`](references/pet-care.md) |

The school year planner is in `references/school-year-planner.md`. The vaccine and registration rules are in `references/law-and-vaccines.md`.

## Check before done

- Never diagnose, never say "it is probably normal", and never suggest a medicine, supplement or dose. The doctor, midwife or vet decides.
- Danger signs in pregnancy (bleeding, water breaking, seizure, severe headache, fainting) → **call 1669 or go to the hospital now**, before anything else in the answer.
- The ID number, blood group and health details stay in a private file. Never post them in a group chat.
- A shareable table shows "ยา ตามตาราง" and a time, not drug names.
- Say once that this is general information, not medical, veterinary, tax or legal advice.
- A whole care setup with several steps → playbook `superuser/references/playbook-care-setup.md`.


## reference: budget-and-example.md

# Pet budget and worked example

## Budget (plan with your own vet's prices)

| Item | Per year (example to replace with real quotes) |
|---|---|
| Vaccines (core + rabies) | (รอยืนยัน — ask the clinic) |
| Flea/tick/heartworm prevention | (รอยืนยัน) |
| Food (by weight and brand) | kg/month × price × 12 |
| Grooming, litter, toys | |
| Annual check-up and blood test for older pets | (รอยืนยัน) |
| Emergency fund | target: one surgery-sized bill held aside, or insurance premium |

Fill with your clinic's quotes; numbers marked (รอยืนยัน) are not prices. Add the total to `trading-finance` `budget-and-debt` (if installed).

## Worked example

Puppy adopted 1 July 2026 at 8 weeks. Vet plan: core vaccine 1 July, boosters 29 July and 26 August, rabies at 12–16 weeks (with the August visit, vet's decision), microchip with registration at the สำนักงานเขต (check fee). Reminders: rabies booster August 2027; monthly prevention on the 1st. The family adds a line "ฉีดพิษสุนัขบ้าแล้ว — เลขสติกเกอร์ ___" to the record so boarding and the เขต can see it at once.

## Worked example

## Worked example

Mother, 78, Bangkok, บัตรทอง at a district hospital, blood pressure and diabetes, 5 medicines. Family set-up: medicine table copied from the hospital list; pill organiser filled Sunday by the eldest; appointments every 3 months — the second child drives and brings the medicine bag and the question list (dizzy when standing up, twice this month, dates noted). Rights: เบี้ยยังชีพ 700 บาท/เดือน (age 70–79) paid on the 10th; turns 80 next year → amount moves to 800 automatically by age band (confirm with the เขต office). Tax: the daughter who supports her claims ลดหย่อนบิดามารดา 30,000 (one child per parent).


## reference: elder-care.md

<!-- merged from skill `elder-care` on 2026-11-27 · description was: Use when a Thai family cares for an elderly parent -->
# Elder Care (Thailand)

Organise, remind and prepare. This skill never diagnoses, never suggests a medicine and never changes a dose — it copies what the doctor and the medicine label say and turns worries into questions for the next appointment.

General information, not medical or legal advice — ask the doctor or pharmacist (เภสัชกร) about medicines and the local องค์การปกครองส่วนท้องถิ่น (อปท.) or สำนักงานหลักประกันสุขภาพแห่งชาติ (สปสช.) about rights.

**Privacy:** the profile card holds the ID number, blood group, conditions and allergies. Keep it in a private place (`family-legal`, or a locked note), not in a shared family folder. Never post the ID number or medical details to a group chat; a shareable week table shows "ยา ตามตาราง" and a time, not drug names.

## Workflow

1. **Profile** — one page: name, ID number, blood group, allergies, conditions, health-coverage scheme and main hospital, doctors, emergency contacts (template in [references/care-templates.md](care-templates.md))
2. **Medicines (summary)** — bring the actual bag of medicines (ถุงยาเดิม) to every appointment so the doctor can reconcile; copy each medicine into the table in [references/care-templates.md](care-templates.md) exactly as the label or ใบรายการยา says; never change, skip or double a dose — questions go to the doctor or pharmacist. For the full daily schedule, label-word guide and refill method use `health-admin`
3. **Appointments** — put every ใบนัด in the family calendar with who drives; note fasting instructions (งดน้ำงดอาหาร)
4. **Questions for the doctor** — collect during the month: new symptoms with date, falls, sleep, appetite, side effects noticed. Ask: what is each medicine for, what side effects to watch, what to do if a dose is missed, when to come back sooner
5. **Rights check** — the table below, once a year and when anything changes
6. **Home safety** — run the checklist once, then every 6 months
7. **Handoff note** — whenever someone else takes over for a day or more

## Rights and welfare

| Right | Who / amount | How |
|---|---|---|
| เบี้ยยังชีพผู้สูงอายุ (old-age allowance) | 60–69 ปี 600 · 70–79 ปี 700 · 80–89 ปี 800 · 90+ ปี 1,000 บาท/เดือน | Register at the อปท. (เทศบาล/อบต./สำนักงานเขต in Bangkok) where the person is in the ทะเบียนบ้าน; people turning 60 in the next fiscal year register in advance. Paid on the 10th of each month (earlier working day if a holiday). A 2568 report of new bands 700/850/1,000/1,250 is disputed; prd.go.th and Bangkok Biznews (9 Oct 2569) still show 600–1,000 — checked 2026-10-22, confirm with the อปท. (รอยืนยัน) |
| Eligibility condition | Under the ระเบียบกระทรวงมหาดไทย พ.ศ. 2566 the allowance is for people without other state pensions/welfare; the "ไม่มีรายได้เพียงพอ" criterion and later amendments (รอยืนยัน the current rule with the อปท.) | |
| บัตรทอง / หลักประกันสุขภาพแห่งชาติ (Universal Coverage Scheme, UCS) | Thai citizens without another scheme | สปสช. hotline 1330; check or change the registered hospital in the สปสช. app / LINE @nhso |
| สิทธิข้าราชการ (Civil Servant Medical Benefit Scheme, CSMBS) | Parents of a government officer are covered via the officer | กรมบัญชีกลาง; register the parents in the officer's family data |
| ประกันสังคม | Insured under มาตรา 33 / 39 continue their own cover; pension or lump sum at 55+ after leaving work | สำนักงานประกันสังคม hotline 1506 — see `e-commerce` `thai-employment` (if installed) |
| Children's tax deduction for parents | ลดหย่อนบิดามารดา 30,000 บาท/คน (parent 60+, income ≤ 30,000/yr; one child claims per parent); parents' health insurance premium up to 15,000 | `trading-finance` `income-tax-th` (if installed) |
| Other | ศูนย์ช่วยเหลือสังคม 1300; disability card (บัตรคนพิการ) if eligible; travel discounts (รอยืนยัน current list) | |

Sources and check dates: [references/sources.md](elder-care/sources.md)

## Home safety checklist (falls are the main risk)

- [ ] Bathroom: grab bars by toilet and shower, non-slip mat or floor coating, shower chair, no step at the door if possible
- [ ] Bedroom on the ground floor if stairs are hard; bed height so feet are flat on the floor when sitting
- [ ] Night lights from bed to toilet; light switch reachable from bed
- [ ] Remove loose rugs, cables across walkways, clutter on stairs; handrails on both sides of stairs
- [ ] Phone or call bell within reach; emergency numbers large on the wall: 1669 ambulance
- [ ] One named person in charge of medicines, checked against the table
- [ ] Water heater temperature not scalding; gas stove with auto shut-off or switch to induction
- [ ] Shoes with closed heels and non-slip soles; walking aid at the right height (ask the physiotherapist)

## Related

`kids-school.md` (one family calendar) · `family-week` (soft, low-salt menus) · `home-upkeep` (grab bars, lighting as a job) · `personal-life` `family-legal` (ID, ทะเบียนบ้าน, hospital card, will) · `trading-finance` `income-tax-th` · `personal-life` `health-admin` (full medicine schedule and refills) · `personal-life` `health-admin` (symptom list, questions and visit record)


## reference: kids-school.md

<!-- merged from skill `kids-school` on 2026-11-27 · description was: Use when a Thai family plans a child's school year -->
# Kids and School (Thailand)

A school year has 3 money peaks (enrolment, term 1 start, term 2 start) and 1 paperwork peak (enrolment or transfer). Plan for those 4 dates; the rest is routine.

General information, not tax or legal advice — the school, เขตพื้นที่การศึกษา and กรมสรรพากร are the authorities.

## The Thai school year (public schools under สำนักงานคณะกรรมการการศึกษาขั้นพื้นฐาน, สพฐ.)

| Period | Usual timing | Plan for |
|---|---|---|
| Enrolment / admission (รับนักเรียน) | ม.ค.–เม.ย.; อนุบาล/ป.1/ม.1/ม.4 have published timetables | Documents, entrance test, fees deposit |
| ภาคเรียนที่ 1 | mid-May → early October | Uniforms, books, term fees, tutoring sign-up |
| Mid-year break (ปิดภาคเรียน) | October | Camp / childcare cover |
| ภาคเรียนที่ 2 | early November → end of March | Term 2 fees, exams in Feb–Mar |
| Long break | April → mid-May | Summer course, next year's supplies |

Exact dates differ each year and for private and international schools — use the school's own calendar (ปฏิทินการศึกษา) (รอยืนยัน for any date before the school announces it).

## Fees: what is free and what is not

Public schools follow the เรียนฟรี 15 ปี policy (อนุบาล to ม.6), which funds tuition, textbooks, a uniform allowance, learning supplies and student activities — amounts per head are set by สพฐ. each year (รอยืนยัน the current figures). Parents usually still pay for: extra programmes (English Program / Gifted), extra uniforms (sports, scout), school trips, lunch top-ups, insurance, parents' association donations. Private schools charge full term fees plus a one-off entry fee.

Use [references/school-year-planner.md](school-year-planner.md) to lay fees out by month.

## Enrolment and transfer documents

| Document | New enrolment | Transfer (ย้ายโรงเรียน) |
|---|---|---|
| สูติบัตร (birth certificate) — copy | ✔ | |
| ทะเบียนบ้าน of child and parents — copy (some schools give priority by registered district) | ✔ | ✔ |
| บัตรประจำตัวประชาชน of parents/guardian — copy | ✔ | ✔ |
| Child's ID card (from age 7) — copy | ✔ (if issued) | ✔ |
| Photos (uniform, size per school) | ✔ | ✔ |
| ปพ.1 (transcript) from previous school | ป.1 not needed; ม.1/ม.4 ✔ | ✔ |
| Transfer letter / ใบย้าย and ปพ.1 from the old school | | ✔ |
| Vaccination record (สมุดสีชมพู) | often requested for อนุบาล | |
| Name/surname change certificate, guardianship papers if applicable | ✔ | ✔ |

Sign every copy "สำเนาถูกต้อง" and keep the originals in `family-legal`.

## Tutoring decision

Ask before paying: what exact gap (subject, grade, test)? For how many weeks? How will we know it worked (school mark, practice test)? Prefer short blocks (8–10 weeks) with a review over open-ended monthly fees.

## 5-minute check at home (ทบทวนความเข้าใจ)

Before paying for tutoring, or when homework comes back wrong, find out what the child actually misunderstands.

1. **Take the topic from the child's own textbook chapter or worksheet**, not from a curriculum list. The core-curriculum indicator codes of สพฐ. were not checked for this skill (ยังไม่ได้ตรวจ), so none are quoted here.
2. **1–3 questions per idea.** For multiple choice, each wrong option comes from a real common mistake, so the answer shows which mistake it is. Example (ป.3 fractions): "พิซซ่าแบ่ง 4 ชิ้นไม่เท่ากัน กินไป 1 ชิ้น กินไป 1/4 ไหม" — a child who says yes thinks the bottom number counts pieces, not equal parts.
3. **A short guide for the parent:** "ตอบแบบนี้ แปลว่า … ลองทำต่อแบบนี้ …", one line per wrong option.
4. **Positive, specific words only.** Say what the child did ("นับชิ้นถูก แต่ยังไม่ได้ดูว่าชิ้นเท่ากันไหม"), never อ่อน · โง่ · ตามไม่ทัน.
5. Same gap in 2 checks a week apart → that gap is what tutoring is for (decision questions above). The agent does not make up exam questions "from the real test".

## Tax and grants pointer

| Item | Amount | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Child deduction (ลดหย่อนบุตร) | 30,000 บาท/คน | Child under 20, or under 25 and studying, with income below the limit |
| Second child onward born 2561 or later | 60,000 บาท/คน | |
| Pregnancy and childbirth (ฝากครรภ์และคลอดบุตร) | up to 60,000 บาท/ครรภ์ | Receipts from hospital |
| เงินอุดหนุนเพื่อการเลี้ยงดูเด็กแรกเกิด (child support grant) | 600 บาท/เดือน to age 6 (รอยืนยัน) | Household income test; register at the local administrative organisation (องค์กรปกครองส่วนท้องถิ่น · อปท.) / district (รอยืนยัน current criteria) |

For planning which parent claims which child, and the full list, use `trading-finance` `income-tax-th` (if installed).

## Workflow

1. **Calendar** — copy the school's ปฏิทินการศึกษา into the family calendar: term starts, exam weeks, parent meetings, holidays
2. **Fees** — list every fee by month in the planner; add uniforms, books and supplies the month before term
3. **Documents** — 2 months before enrolment, run the checklist above; make 3 sets of signed copies
4. **Health** — check the vaccination record against the school's request; dental and eye checks in the April break
5. **Tutoring** — use the decision questions; review at the end of each block
6. **Tax** — at year end, collect birth certificates and hospital receipts for `trading-finance` `income-tax-th` (if installed)

## References

- [`school-year-planner.md`](school-year-planner.md) — fee planner by month and a worked example for 2 children
- [`sources.md`](kids-school/sources.md) — tax deduction sources (checked 2026-10-06) and credits

## Related

`family-week` (lunch boxes) · `elder-care.md` (grandparent pick-up roster in the handoff note) · `trading-finance` `income-tax-th` (if installed) · `trading-finance` `budget-and-debt` (if installed) · `family-legal`


## reference: law-and-vaccines.md

# Pet law and vaccine schedule

General information, not veterinary or legal advice. The vet decides vaccines and medicines; the local เขต/เทศบาล/ปศุสัตว์อำเภอ is the authority on registration.

## The law

| Law | What it means for owners |
|---|---|
| พ.ร.บ.โรคพิษสุนัขบ้า พ.ศ. 2535 มาตรา 5 | Owners must have every controlled animal (dogs, cats and others named by regulation) vaccinated against rabies by a vet or authorised person, on the schedule set by regulation; a vaccination tag/certificate is issued each time. Penalty for not vaccinating: fine up to 200 บาท under มาตรา 21 (iLaw, กรมปศุสัตว์ summary and local bylaws in the Royal Gazette agree — confirmed 2026-10-26) |
| Schedule under the law | Dogs: first vaccine at 2–4 months old, the next dose by the date on the vaccination certificate (confirmed). The law itself does not say "every year" — yearly boosters are the กรมปศุสัตว์ recommendation. Cats are controlled animals under a 2560 ministerial regulation, first dose at 2–4 months (รอยืนยัน) |
| Local registration | Many local authorities require dog registration and/or a microchip under their own ข้อบัญญัติ. Bangkok: the 2548 dog bylaw applies now, and the Bangkok veterinary office microchips and registers for free; the commonly quoted 120-day deadline and 450-baht fee were not confirmed (รอยืนยัน). A new Bangkok animal-keeping bylaw (ข้อบัญญัติ … การควบคุมการเลี้ยงหรือปล่อยสัตว์ พ.ศ. 2567) was announced with compulsory microchips, a cap on animals by home size and fines. Its start date has been postponed: look up the current start date, caps and fines live (WebSearch/WebFetch, Bangkok Metropolitan Administration site or the สำนักงานเขต) before quoting; if the page will not open, mark the value (รอยืนยัน) |
| พ.ร.บ.ป้องกันการทารุณกรรมและการจัดสวัสดิภาพสัตว์ พ.ศ. 2557 | Owners must provide proper food, shelter and care; abandonment is an offence |

Free rabies vaccination campaigns are run by local authorities and ปศุสัตว์ — usually around World Rabies Day (28 September) and ahead of the hot season (รอยืนยัน local dates).

## Typical vaccine and prevention schedule

What the vet commonly follows (the vet decides — use this only to know what to ask):

| Age / interval | Dog | Cat |
|---|---|---|
| 6–8 weeks | Core combination vaccine (distemper, parvo, hepatitis) | Core combination (panleukopenia, calicivirus, herpesvirus) |
| every 3–4 weeks until ~16 weeks | Core boosters | Core boosters |
| 3–4 months | **Rabies (legal requirement)** | **Rabies (legal requirement)** |
| 1 year, then yearly or as the vet says | Core booster + **rabies yearly** | Core booster + **rabies yearly** |
| Monthly or per product | Flea/tick and heartworm prevention — ask the vet | Flea prevention |
| Every 3–6 months | Deworming per vet | Deworming per vet |
| 6 months+ | Discuss neutering (ทำหมัน) | Discuss neutering |

Sources and check date: [`sources.md`](sources.md).


## reference: pet-care.md

<!-- merged from skill `pet-care` on 2026-11-27 · description was: Use when a Thai family keeps a dog or cat, no vet diagnosis -->
# pet-care — one record, calendar and budget for a family's dog or cat in Thailand

General information, not veterinary or legal advice. The vet decides vaccines and medicines; the local เขต/เทศบาล/ปศุสัตว์อำเภอ is the authority on registration. This skill never suggests a medicine or a dose.

## Use when
- A Thai family keeps a dog or cat and wants a vaccine calendar, a record, a vet-visit checklist or a yearly budget.
- The user asks what the law requires (rabies vaccine, registration, microchip) or what vaccine schedule to ask the vet about.

Not for: diagnosis or treatment → the vet · pest treatment safe for pets → `home-upkeep` (ask the contractor) · foods toxic to pets (chocolate, grapes, onion, garlic, xylitol) → `family-week`.

## Steps
1. **Law and schedule questions.** Only the rabies vaccine is required by law (พ.ร.บ.โรคพิษสุนัขบ้า พ.ศ. 2535); everything else is good practice. Open [`law-and-vaccines.md`](law-and-vaccines.md) before quoting the law, registration, microchip rules, or the vaccine schedule. Bangkok's new animal-keeping bylaw has a postponed start date: look up the start date, caps and fines live (WebSearch/WebFetch) before quoting; if the page will not open, mark the value (รอยืนยัน).
2. **One record per animal** — [`pet-record.md`](pet-record.md): ID, microchip number, vaccines with dates and sticker photos, weight log, vet contacts. With a record, the vet visit takes 10 minutes instead of 30.
3. **Calendar:** vaccine due dates, monthly prevention, deworming; set reminders 7 days ahead. For due dates in พ.ศ. or across a year-end: `node skills/family-legal/scripts/due-dates.mjs <file.json>` with `lead_days` 7.
4. **Before each vet visit,** write what changed, since when, eating/drinking/toilet, weight; bring the vaccine book.
5. **After the visit,** copy the vet's instructions exactly into the record and book the next visit before leaving.
6. **Budget:** plan with the user's own vet quotes (items and layout in [`budget-and-example.md`](budget-and-example.md); numbers marked (รอยืนยัน) are not prices). Keep an emergency fund, or compare pet insurance with `decision-desk/decision-scoring`, command `payoff`: `node decide.mjs payoff insurance.json`, starting from [`insurance-payoff-example.json`](insurance-payoff-example.json) (made-up numbers; the user replaces the vet quotes and the chances, which are a guess). It shows expected cost and the biggest regret side by side. When the two disagree (`2 เกณฑ์ไม่ตรงกัน`), do not pick for the user: expected cost fits a choice repeated every year, least regret fits a one-off large bill the user could not pay.
7. **Travel or boarding:** pet hotels ask for the vaccine book; rabies within the last year is usually required.

## Check before done
- No medicine or dose was suggested; any vet decision is marked as the vet's.
- Law or fee values not confirmed live carry (รอยืนยัน).
- The record, the calendar (7-day reminders) and the budget total (added to `trading-finance` `budget-and-debt` if installed) exist.

## References

## reference: pregnancy-and-baby.md

<!-- merged from skill `pregnancy-and-baby` on 2026-11-27 · description was: Use when a Thai family is expecting or has a baby, no diagnosis -->
# Pregnancy and Baby (Thailand)

> **One rule:** organise visits, rights and paperwork; never judge a symptom. Any danger sign below → **call 1669 or go to the hospital where she is booked (ห้องคลอด) now**, before anything else in the answer.

General information to help organise, not medical advice. The doctor or midwife decides tests, medicines and vaccines; this skill never suggests a medicine, supplement dose or "it is probably normal".

## Danger signs — hospital now, not the next visit

Bleeding from the vagina · water breaking or fluid leaking · the baby moving less than usual · severe headache, blurred vision, sudden swelling of face or hands · seizure (ชัก) · severe abdominal pain · high fever · vomiting that does not stop. Seizure, heavy bleeding or fainting → **1669**. (List from hospital patient leaflets; no Department of Health page found on the check date — รอยืนยัน the full list with the ANC clinic, but never wait to confirm in an emergency.)

## Use when / not when

| Situation | Use |
|---|---|
| Just found out, planning ANC visits, maternity pay and leave | this skill |
| Birth registration, newborn grant, baby vaccine calendar | this skill |
| Questions to bring to an ANC visit, recording what the doctor said | `health-admin` |
| Medicines prescribed during pregnancy into a schedule | `health-admin` (copy the label, never change) |
| Leave forms and what the employer must pay | `thai-employment` (e-commerce, if installed) |
| School years later | `kids-school.md` |

## 1 · Antenatal care (ฝากครรภ์)

- **Start before 12 weeks.** The Thai quality ANC guideline (กรมอนามัย 2565) sets **8 visits**; สปสช. pays for 8 (raised from 5 on 12 Aug 2569) and more when the doctor says so.
- Usual weeks: ≤12 · 20 · 26 · 30 · 34 · 36 · 38 · 40 (WHO 2016 pattern; no Thai page listed the weeks — รอยืนยัน with the clinic).
- Thai citizens under บัตรทอง get ANC free at the registered unit, including thalassaemia and Down syndrome screening; other schemes and ultrasound cover — ask (รอยืนยัน).
- Keep the pink book (สมุดบันทึกสุขภาพแม่และเด็ก) in the bag for every visit.

## 2 · Money and leave

| Right | Amount / rule | Status |
|---|---|---|
| ประกันสังคม มาตรา 33/39 childbirth lump sum | 15,000 บาท per birth, no limit on number; if both parents insured, one claims | confirmed |
| SSO maternity pay | 50% of average wage (wage base cap 17,500 from 1 Jan 2569, see scripts/check/facts.json) for 90 days; condition: 5 months' contributions in the 15 months before the birth month (รอยืนยัน: secondary sources disagree, no official page checked); form สปส. 2-01 + สูติบัตร | official page; รอยืนยัน whether days changed after the 2568 labour law |
| Maternity leave (พ.ร.บ.คุ้มครองแรงงาน ฉบับที่ 9 พ.ศ. 2568, in force 7 Dec 2568) | up to 120 days; employer pays up to 60 days; father 15 days' leave to help after birth | confirmed |
| SSO child allowance (สงเคราะห์บุตร) | 1,000 บาท/month per child, birth to 6 years, up to 3 children; 12 months' contributions in 36 months; since 1 Jan 2568 | confirmed (old sso.go.th page still says 400 — outdated) |
| มาตรา 40 | only plan 3 has child allowance; amount รอยืนยัน | รอยืนยัน |
| Newborn grant (เงินอุดหนุนเพื่อการเลี้ยงดูเด็กแรกเกิด) | 600 บาท/month to age 6, household income ≤ 100,000 บาท/person/year, forms ดร.01/ดร.02 at the อปท./เขต, check at csgcheck.dcy.go.th or the ทางรัฐ app | confirmed · making it universal from fiscal year 2570 was approved by the committee 14 Jul 2569 but no cabinet resolution found (รอยืนยัน) |

Typical pay in practice: employer 60 days full wage + SSO 50% for 90 days — ask HR how they overlap at your company.

## 3 · Birth registration (แจ้งเกิด)

- **Within 15 days** at the registrar where the baby was born (hospital births: the อำเภอ/เขต/เทศบาล of the hospital); another district is possible with the hospital certificate and 2 witnesses.
- Bring: hospital birth certificate (ท.ร.1/1), the house registration (เจ้าบ้าน copy) for the baby's address, ID cards of the parents and the person notifying.
- Late: the นายอำเภอ approves, fine up to 1,000 บาท.
- Then: add the baby to ทะเบียนบ้าน, claim SSO lump sum and child allowance, register the newborn grant, choose the health scheme.

## 4 · Baby vaccine calendar (EPI, free)

| Age | Vaccines |
|---|---|
| Birth | BCG · Hepatitis B (+1 month if the mother carries hepatitis B) |
| 2 months | DTP-HepB-Hib · IPV · Rotavirus |
| 4 months | DTP-HepB-Hib · IPV · Rotavirus |
| 6 months | DTP-HepB-Hib · OPV · Rotavirus |
| 9 months | MMR |
| 1 year | JE (live, LAJE) |
| 1.5 years | DTP · OPV · MMR |
| 2.5 years | LAJE |
| 4 years | DTP · OPV |
| ป.5 girls | HPV (number of doses changed recently — รอยืนยัน) |
| ป.6 | Td |

Source: WHO Thailand EPI factsheet 2024; the กรมควบคุมโรค PDF is an image only, so the table stays (รอยืนยัน) — **the pink book and the clinic's schedule win**. Optional (paid) vaccines: ask the paediatrician. Put each due date in the family calendar 7 days ahead.

## Worked example

[references/worked-example.md](worked-example.md) — open when you want a model plan for an office worker (ANC calendar · pay · registration).

## Check before sending

- [ ] Danger-sign line with 1669 is in the answer
- [ ] No symptom judged, no medicine or supplement suggested
- [ ] Every amount says its status; (รอยืนยัน) items are named to the user as not yet confirmed
- [ ] Dates are real dates in the user's calendar, not just "week 20"

Related: `health-admin` · `family-legal` (สูติบัตร, pink book photo) · `kids-school.md` · `trading-finance` `income-tax-th` (if installed — ลดหย่อนฝากครรภ์และคลอดบุตร)

## References

- [`sources.md`](sources.md) — open to re-check dated figures, prices and rules, and their sources

|---|---|---|---|
| พ.ค. | ค่าธรรมเนียมภาคเรียน 1 | | ☐ |
| พ.ค. | ชุดนักเรียน / รองเท้า | | ☐ |
| พ.ค. | หนังสือ อุปกรณ์ | | ☐ |
| | ค่าเรียนพิเศษ | | ☐ |
| พ.ย. | ค่าธรรมเนียมภาคเรียน 2 | | ☐ |

| **รวมทั้งปี** | | | |

## Tutoring log

| วิชา | ครู / สถาบัน | เริ่ม | จบ | ค่าใช้จ่าย | เป้าหมาย | ผลหลังจบ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | | | | | | |

## Worked example

2 children, public school, ป.3 and ม.1 (EP programme). Term 1 May: EP fee for ม.1 15,000 (example, รอยืนยัน the school's figure) + uniforms 2,500 + supplies 1,500; ป.3 extras 1,200. Monthly sinking fund: (15,000 × 2 terms + 4,000 extras × 2 + tutoring 8 weeks × 800 × 2) ÷ 12 ≈ 4,233 บาท/เดือน put aside from June. Tax: older child born 2557 → 30,000; younger born 2562 (second child, after 2561) → 60,000.

## reference: worked-example.md

# Worked example · pregnancy-and-baby

Office worker, มาตรา 33, positive test at 7 weeks, due 20 Jun 2570. Plan: book first ANC this week (before 12 weeks) at the hospital where she will deliver; 8 visits into the calendar; pink book in the work bag. Money: 15,000 lump sum + SSO 50% for 90 days (wage base 17,500 → 8,750 a month) + employer 60 days full pay; check the SSO contribution count (needs 5 of the last 15 months). After birth: register at the เขต of the hospital within 15 days (by 5 Jul 2570), claim สปส. 2-01, child allowance 1,000/month, ask the เขต about the 600-baht grant. Vaccine calendar from the pink book.
